goal: Prevent periodic wallet rebroadcasts from leaking transactions over standard connections
Preserves origin privacy for users who explicitly enable private broadcast
reviewability: Needs rebase against master before code review is worthwhile
Author has been inactive for over four months
agreement: Concept supported to complete private broadcast coverage for wallet transactions (pablomartin4btc, w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: dispatches can split dependent transactions and break CPFP rebroadcasts (achow101)
Suggested that package private broadcast could address the CPFP rebroadcast failures (andrewtoth)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because periodic rebroadcasts can deanonymize users who opted into private broadcast
Prevents unconfirmed transactions from leaking to all peers during resubmission sweeps

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it routes wallet traffic through existing private broadcast facilities
P2P wire protocols and core network relay mechanics are unchanged
